evidence: The paper builds individual decision tree models and ranks features by AUC: "Putrescine (AUC = 0.98), PC ae C40:3 (AUC = 0.96)...Each decision tree model was built using one biomolecule at a time...discriminative performances of each model were assessed...using the area under the curve (AUC)." Biomarker identification relies on this AUC ranking, not on impurity-based importance. The ranking is validated through held-out ROC/AUC performance, which is robust to the impurity-importance bias that corrupts Gini/MDI magnitude and ranking.
